_source.time_unit: TIME is in units of 1/100000 s

_reason: The scripts carry no lyric text: LYRIC holds only the character *index* within the line, and no lyric string, kana table or song text exists anywhere in the shipped rom data (searched: script, 2d, pv_expression and tables directories). P(mouth | phoneme) therefore cannot be measured from this data set, and a hand-written kana table would be exactly the guess this solver must not make.
_what_would_unblock_it: a lyric text source, or a vocal stem plus forced alignment; the solver already accepts an external phoneme timeline through `evidence.phonemes` so neither requires touching the solver.
